name: Nuvio iOS (Unofficial AltStore Source)
subtitle: A free, open-source media app — unofficial AltStore-compatible source for iOS and iPadOS.
description: An unofficial AltStore source for Nuvio on iPhone and iPad. Nuvio turns your own media sources into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and synchronized progress. IPAs are served directly from NuvioMedia's public GitHub releases. This community source is not affiliated with or supported by NuvioMedia.

apps.name: Nuvio
apps.subtitle: Bring your own sources.
apps.localizedDescription: Nuvio is a free, open-source media app for your phone, desktop, and TV. Bring your own sources and turn them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen. Requires iPhone or iPad with iOS 16.1 or later.
